xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4371: Jev turn-end classifier: label why an agent ended its turn (Needs-you + stall sweeper), observability only

plan.title: Jev turn-end classifier: label why an agent ended its turn (Needs-you + stall sweeper), observability only
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One vertical feature that was already split out of the Jev research PRD as its own sibling issue (Issue 1 of 4). The file count comes from one optional field travelling through every hop it must cross (lib assessor, transcript reader, store, contracts schema + reducer, server poll, frontend store/row/derive) plus the eval fixtures and three doc files the issue names. The subsystem count is inflated because each docs/ and evals/ file counts separately. Splitting server and frontend halves would ship a contract field with no consumer, or a label with no producer.

narratives.Problem: When an agent ends its turn, Overdeck cannot tell a question from a report. computeAgentEnrichment marks every idle interactive agent (plan role or conv-* id) with the pending kind agentTurnEnded, labelled 'Answer the agent', because a prose question has no tool call and no modal. The frontend's isBareTurnEnd must assume the agent asked nothing. Work, review and test agents are excluded from agentTurnEnded, so a work agent that stops blocked or stops to ask is surfaced only as a generic idle-running parked row ('poke for progress').
narratives.Proposal: Add an optional, off-by-default Jev classification of the last assistant message. src/lib/jev/turn-end.ts assesses {role, last_message (tail <= 6000 chars)} with a five-way Choice and a Noul; results below TURN_END_MIN_CONFIDENCE (0.7) are dropped server-side. src/lib/agents/last-assistant-message.ts reads the last assistant message from claude-code JSONL and codex rollouts by reusing the existing parsers. src/lib/jev/turn-end-store.ts holds an in-process, mtime-keyed store with a synchronous peek and a fire-and-forget schedule; the feature gate is checked before any I/O. The enrichment poll peeks before computing and schedules after, never awaiting; the value travels as an optional turnEndAssessment through @overdeck/contracts to the Needs-you row badge ('Asked you a question' / 'Reported done' / 'Blocked') and to isBareTurnEnd (a confident asks_operator is a real question). The parked resolver appends 'last message reads as: <label> (<conf>)' to idle-running rows (details.turnEnd + parkReason) and the stall sweeper copies it into its recommendation evidence while still acting on nothing. A sanitized 40+ message fixture set and evals/jev-turn-end.eval.ts measure per-class precision and recall.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to deacon-lite: checkStuckWorkAgents and every other routine send exactly the same nudges as today; no suppression and no new nudge text (that is the unfiled phase 2, item 1b).
- No rescheduling of runStallSweeperPatrol and no new sweeper capability: no spawn, stop, message, kill, dispatch, clear or reset.
- No change to /api/parked (src/dashboard/server/routes/parked.ts) or /api/velocity.
- No change to the conversation REST pending-input feed; the label reaches only enrichment-sourced agent rows.
- No new pending-input kind; no change to BLOCKING_KINDS, Decision grouping or sort order.
- No persistence of any assessment: nothing written to agent rows, sessions.json, the pipeline journal, the tracker, the event store beyond the existing enrichment event, or any file; no eval decision log.
- No hardcoded Jev model and no default model outside tests.
- No transcript support beyond claude-code JSONL and codex rollouts; other harnesses report unsupported-harness.
- No awaiting variant of the resolver (pan parked stays peek-and-schedule).
- No frontend copy of TURN_END_MIN_CONFIDENCE; no label for progress_update or other.
- No change to src/dashboard/server/routes/agents/listing.ts output.
- Nothing beyond the agent role and the last assistant message tail is sent to TypeSafe.

autoDecisions.summary: Initial thresholds: TURN_END_MIN_CONFIDENCE = 0.7 on the Choice confidence; needsAnswer = needs_operator_answer Noul >= 0.5.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names the constant but no value; the live smoke test showed Choice confidence of 0.66-0.77 on a clear case, so 0.7 is the midpoint that suppresses the weakest readings. The eval (WI-12) tunes it and any change bumps QUESTION_SET_VERSION.

autoDecisions.summary: Strict peek-and-schedule everywhere, including the parked resolver used by pan parked; no await path anywhere.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue design says consumers never wait on Jev and Phase-2 bars changing what runs. Planning found runStallSweeperPatrol has had no caller since PAN-3917 W4 (94255f055fe), so the work-agent evidence has no live emitter; that is recorded as a finding and hazard, not fixed here.

autoDecisions.summary: The assessment lands in ParkedRow.details.turnEnd plus a clause appended to parkReason, and in the sweeper's recommend() evidence object as turnEnd.
autoDecisions.rationale: ParkedRow has no evidence field. The sweeper's activity sentence already interpolates row.parkReason, and recommend()'s second argument is spread into the sweep.recommendation payload, which is the evidence the AC means.

autoDecisions.summary: Only asks_operator, reports_complete and reports_blocked replace 'Answer the agent'; progress_update and other keep it.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names exactly three labels; unknown or weak readings must look like today.

autoDecisions.summary: In @overdeck/contracts the TurnEndAssessment.kind field is Schema.String, not a literal union.
autoDecisions.rationale: The event store is append-only; a literal union would make a future kind rename fail replay decode. The lib type keeps the literal union.

autoDecisions.summary: The '>= 0.9 asks_operator precision before docs call it ready' criterion is an implementation checkpoint with a fallback wording ('advisory; accuracy under measurement').
autoDecisions.rationale: Measuring needs a Jev key on the host, which the work agent may not have; the fallback keeps the item completable without inventing numbers.

autoDecisions.summary: The frontend AC uses a stubbed agent-sourced Decision for a conv-* id, not the conversation REST feed.
autoDecisions.rationale: Only computeAgentEnrichment produces agentTurnEnded; the REST conversation feed never does, and changing it is out of scope.

items.title: Add the turn-end question set and assessTurnEnd

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In src/lib/jev/questions.ts bump QUESTION_SET_VERSION 1 -> 2 and add TURN_END_KINDS, TurnEndKind, TURN_END_MIN_CONFIDENCE = 0.7, TURN_END_NEEDS_ANSWER_THRESHOLD = 0.5, TURN_END_STATE_MAX_CHARS = 6000 and TURN_END_QUESTIONS (Choice turn_end_kind with the five one-sentence criteria from the PRD, Noul needs_operator_answer with the issue's exact wording). Create src/lib/jev/turn-end.ts exporting TurnEndAssessment, TurnEndInput, TurnEndOutcome, buildTurnEndState (keeps the LAST 6000 chars), assessTurnEnd (calls assess('jevTurnEndAssessment', ...), maps answered/unavailable/failed, returns unassessed 'empty-message' without a call for blank text, never throws), toTurnEndView (drops confidence < 0.7) and formatTurnEndSummary ('last message reads as: <asked the operator|done|blocked|progress update|other> (<conf to 2 dp>)'). Tests reuse the fake-fetch and cost-events mock pattern from src/lib/jev/__tests__/client.test.ts and call resetJevMemo() in beforeEach.

Given confidence 0.69, toTurnEndView returns undefined; given 0.7 it returns the assessment
Given the jevTurnEndAssessment toggle off, when assessTurnEnd is called, then the fake fetch is never invoked and the outcome is unassessed
formatTurnEndSummary for a reports_blocked 0.84 view returns exactly 'last message reads as: blocked (0.84)'
Read an agent's last assistant message from claude JSONL or codex rollout

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Create src/lib/agents/last-assistant-message.ts with LAST_ASSISTANT_TAIL_BYTES = 256 KiB, readLastAssistantMessage(agentId, workspace) (resolves via resolveAgentTranscriptCandidate from transcript-resolver.ts) and readLastAssistantMessageFromCandidate(candidate). claude: parseConversationMessages(path, max(0, size - tail)) from src/dashboard/server/services/conversation/parser.ts (a partial first line is skipped by its JSON.parse catch). codex: read the tail with fs/promises, drop the partial first line when offset > 0, push complete lines into createCodexConversationAccumulator(path) from codex-conversation-parser.ts, take .result(size, mtimeMs).messages. Every other TranscriptCandidateKind returns {ok:false, reason:'unsupported-harness'}. Walk messages backwards for the first role 'assistant' with non-empty trimmed text and return {ok:true, messageId: message.id, text, transcriptKind}. No execSync, no new parser. Import getAgentState only from agent-state-read.js if needed.

items.title: Given a claude JSONL whose final assistant entry says 'Should I migrate the callers?', when readLastAssistantMessageFromCandidate runs, then it returns ok true with that text and the parser's message id
Given a claude JSONL larger than LAST_ASSISTANT_TAIL_BYTES, the extractor still returns the final assistant message
Given a codex rollout fixture, the extractor returns its last assistant message text
Given a pi candidate, the extractor returns ok false with reason unsupported-harness; given a transcript with only user lines, it returns reason no-assistant-message
Add the mtime-keyed turn-end store with synchronous peek and fire-and-forget schedule

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. Create src/lib/jev/turn-end-store.ts exporting isTurnEndAssessmentEnabled (resolveJevForFeature('jevTurnEndAssessment', loadConfigSync().config).ok), peekTurnEndAssessment(agentId, transcriptMtime), scheduleTurnEndAssessment({agentId, role, transcriptMtime}, deps?), clearTurnEndAssessment, resetTurnEndStore and TURN_END_STORE_MAX_ENTRIES = 256. The gate is checked first in peek and schedule (closed gate = no transcript read). schedule returns void synchronously, skips when mtime is null, when an entry exists for the same mtime, or when a run for agentId:mtime is in flight; otherwise it starts a swallowed async run that resolves the workspace (default getAgentWorkspace from src/lib/agent-enrichment.ts, the same door getAgentJsonlMtime uses for the mtime the poll passes; a state-row-only lookup would store no-transcript for agents found via the pane-cwd or prefix fallback), reads the last assistant message, calls assessTurnEnd and stores {mtime, messageId, view: toTurnEndView(outcome)} (or {mtime, view: undefined, reason} when unassessed). Every outcome is stored for its mtime. Map capped at 256, oldest evicted. Nothing persisted. Deps are injectable for tests.

Given a readLastAssistantMessage that never resolves, scheduleTurnEndAssessment returns synchronously and a second schedule for the same mtime makes no second read call

narrative.Action: PRD WI-11. Hand-collect final assistant messages from local ~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl transcripts and codex rollouts (read-only; never modify or delete them), label each with one TurnEndKind, and write evals/fixtures/jev-turn-end.json as [{name, role, text, label}]: at least 40 rows and at least 8 each of asks_operator, reports_complete, reports_blocked, progress_update. Sanitize: absolute home paths -> <path>; private names/prefixes (myn, mind your now, krux, tindra, auricle, MIN-, AUR-, KRUX-, TIN-, ELV-) -> <project>/<ISSUE>; drop any message with a token-shaped string or an email; keep the last 6000 characters. Add evals/jev-turn-end.eval.ts and record measured precision

narrative.Action: PRD WI-12. Model on evals/jev-smoke.eval.ts: resolveJevConfig(loadConfigSync().config), evalite.skip with the printed reason when unresolved, one systemOne call per fixture with state buildTurnEndState(role, text), questions TURN_END_QUESTIONS and model resolution.config.model (never a literal). predicted = choice when confidence >= TURN_END_MIN_CONFIDENCE else null; scorer 'predicted equals label'; print perClassMetrics with console.table. Add the row to the evals/README.md table. IMPLEMENTATION CHECKPOINT: if Jev is configured on the host, run the eval and paste the per-class table and jev.model id into the PR description; the ready gate is asks_operator precision >= 0.9. FALLBACK: when not met or not configured, the PR states the measured number or 'not measured', and docs-turn-end uses the wording 'advisory; accuracy under measurement'. Thresholds do not change without bumping QUESTION_SET_VERSION.
